answer: Pinewood Federal Credit Union is in our e-payoff network, so you don't need a payoff letter. We confirm the payoff with them electronically on the day of your appointment using your loan account number, and we send the payoff the same day. You receive whatever is left after the payoff, minus the $99 home pickup fee, by bank draft or direct deposit (direct deposit arrives in 1 to 3 business days). Keep making your loan payments until Pinewood confirms the payoff; if they end up with an extra payment, they refund it to you directly, usually within 2 to 4 weeks after the loan is closed.
